why: g_ambientColor (0x104571D8) is the packed ambient colour dword; its blue byte is converted to float here. IDA types the global _DWORD, and Hex-Rays converts the whole dword.
evidence: 0x100CB9F7: mov eax, [0x104571D8]; mov ecx, eax; and ecx, 0FFh; mov [esp+14h], ecx; mov dword [esp+18h], 0; fild qword [esp+14h] -> v88. The dword is stored packed at 0x100CBB46.
